description: This PHP file defines the SugarModule class, which manages module instances and their related functionalities such as loading beans, checking module templates, and maintaining singleton instances within the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods for retrieving module instances, loading beans, and verifying if a module implements a specific template.

classes.name: SugarModule
classes.description: A class that manages module instances, loading beans, and checking module templates within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of SugarModule for a given module name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarModule object with the specified module name.

methods.name: moduleImplements
methods.description: Checks if the current module implements the specified template.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads and returns the bean object for the module, requiring relevant files if necessary.
